Stash is free and made by volunteers. If it\'s useful to you, consider supporting the project.

Discord has no official way for a phone app to set your status, so Stash signs in as you and uses your account's own session. Discord's rules call that a self-bot and allow them to action the account.

Enforcement goes after spam rather than status updates, so this is unlikely — but it is your account, so it is your call.

Disconnecting clears your status and deletes the token from this phone.
Couldn\'t reach Last.fm. Your plays stay queued and will be sent later.

Stash signs out of %1$s on this phone and stops syncing it. Songs from %1$s still waiting to download are dropped from the queue.\n\nSongs you\'ve already downloaded stay in your library, and you can reconnect any time.

Hearting a track in Stash will also Like it on %1$s, and removing a heart will remove the Like there too. Only likes you add from now on are mirrored.\n\nThis uses the same private endpoint the %1$s web player uses — not an official API. It can stop working at any time and, rarely, unofficial access can get an account flagged. Consider enabling this only on a secondary or backup account.
Disabled due to errors — will re-enable in next update
Send your Stash plays to YouTube Music?
Every track you finish listening to in Stash will be added to your YouTube Music Watch History. Your Daily Mix and other YouTube Music recommendations will learn from your Stash listening.

Stash uses an unofficial YouTube endpoint (the same one the YouTube Music app uses). Google tolerates this pattern for personal-use apps but could change the rules without notice. If that happens, Stash will automatically stop sending plays until a new update fixes the integration.
Rare but not zero chance of YouTube rate-limiting your account. Stash monitors for errors and pauses itself if it sees problems.
Mirror hearts to your accounts. Applies to new likes only.
This build of Stash doesn\'t include a Last.fm API key. A developer rebuilding with a key in local.properties unlocks this feature.
Your browser should be open on Last.fm. Tap \"Yes, allow access\" on their page, then come back and tap Finish below.
Scrobbling your plays. %1$d queued to submit.
Scrobbling your plays. Everything up to date.
Submits \"Artist A\" instead of \"Artist A, Artist B\" so collabs don\'t split your Last.fm stats. Artist names that contain a comma may be shortened.
Open scrobbling from MetaBrainz. Your listening data stays yours and exportable.
Paste your user token from listenbrainz.org/profile.
Scrobbling plays from now on. %1$d queued to submit.
Scrobbling plays from now on. Everything up to date.
Show what you\'re listening to in real time.

Animated color wash behind Now Playing — switch off for a still backdrop that saves battery

Turn on Ambient motion to choose a style.
The tab Stash opens on when you start it.
Arrange Home\'s sections or hide the ones you don\'t use. The Discover hero stays on top.
Playlists and songs other Stash listeners are into. Your posts show your name.
Recently played and your History. Appears after your first listen.
Your Stash, Spotify and YouTube likes as one card in Your playlists
Sets YouTube downloads at the rates below, and JioSaavn at 96 kbps on Low and Normal, 160 on High, 320 on Best and Max.
Streams YouTube at its lowest audio quality — about 2 MB per track instead of 5 — and JioSaavn at 96 kbps instead of 320. Downloads are unaffected.
Stream studio-quality FLAC. Off, songs play via JioSaavn or YouTube. Downloads follow Download quality.
No lossless source configured — see below. Files ~10× larger than MP3.
FLAC for streaming. Downloads follow Download quality.
No lossless source configured — connect your Qobuz account below
Sign in with your own Qobuz subscription for guaranteed lossless.
After every sync, look for lossless versions of your downloads that aren\'t FLAC yet. You can also check by hand in Library Health.
Plays and downloads Tidal\'s 320 kbps AAC when a song has no lossless version. Off = Tidal is used for FLAC only.

Streams CD quality instead of Hi-Res or Max on every network — about 28 MB per track instead of 70 or 140. Tracks that fall to JioSaavn or YouTube use their lowest audio quality. Downloads are unaffected.
Use JioSaavn, then YouTube when a download has no lossless match
Use JioSaavn, then YouTube when Tidal has no AAC of a song
Point Stash at your own lossless relay. It takes priority over Stash\'s.
Optional: use your own BitChord server for Tidal instead of Stash\'s. Leave blank otherwise.
Only if your own server sets ACCESS_TOKEN
qobuz.squid.wtf captcha: paste the captcha_verified_at cookie value directly.
Play a song to see what it goes through on the way to your ears.
Android\'s shared mixer, like every app. It resamples songs that don\'t match its own rate (usually 48 kHz).
Match USB DAC to each song
Your DAC runs at the song\'s own sample rate — 44.1, 96, 192 kHz — so nothing is resampled. EQ, crossfade and notifications still work.
Every sample reaches your DAC unaltered. EQ, normalization and crossfade are bypassed, and volume is set on your DAC. Falls back to matching the sample rate where your phone doesn\'t offer it.
These apply to USB DACs and USB-C dongles. The phone\'s own headphone jack, speaker and Bluetooth always go through Android\'s mixer. Bluetooth also re-encodes the audio.

In bit-perfect mode Android doesn\'t touch the volume: your DAC sets it. If your DAC has no volume control of its own, the phone\'s volume keys may stop working and music can play at full level.\n\nTurn the volume down before you press play. EQ, normalization and crossfade are bypassed while bit-perfect is active.
Any amount on Ko-fi unlocks unlimited lossless. Enter the email you used on Ko-fi and we\'ll send you a code.
If %1$s is on our Ko-fi list, a code is on its way. It can take a minute.
Remove supporter code from this device
Lossless comes from the sources above. Misses try JioSaavn before falling back to YouTube, shown as \"via YT\" while it plays.
Allow streaming over mobile data (5G / LTE). Off by default to avoid surprise data use.
Skip Qobuz and stream everything via YouTube. Turn this on if lossless playback is down or only playing short clips.
Debug builds only. Routes streaming and downloads through Qobuz with no YouTube fallback.
Streaming is unavailable in this build.
When the last song in the queue starts, keep the music going with a radio seeded from it. Needs a connection.
Fade the ending track into the next on auto-advance. Manual skips still cut instantly.

Word-synced lyrics are off. Switching back doesn\'t re-fetch anything right away — tracks pick up Apple Music\'s word-synced lyrics the next time they\'re fetched (a new release\'s automatic pass, or \"Fetch lyrics\" in Library Health).
Prefers Apple Music\'s word-synced lyrics. Switching to LRC only removes any stored word-synced lyrics and re-fetches from line-synced sources — use \"Fetch lyrics\" in Library Health to run it now.
Most conservative. Downloads only when on Wi-Fi and plugged in.
Downloads over Wi-Fi even without a charger.
Downloads over cellular too. Uses mobile data.
Daily Discover, Deep Cuts, and First Listen mixes auto-refresh in the background.
Auto-generated mix playlists are hidden. Background discovery downloads are off.
New Releases, Qobuz Playlists, and Top Albums show on Home.
Home keeps only your mixes and imported music.

Export settings and database or import from a previous backup.
Tracks are stored in this folder and survive uninstall. Visible to other apps and over USB.
New downloads go to the selected location.
Nested folders — one per artist, one per album inside it.
All tracks directly in one folder, named artist - title.
One folder per playlist; tracks without a playlist use Artist / Album.
